external_cache_policy: Raw responses, headers, extracted source text and pixel QA stay in the local calibration-primary-sources cache outside the repository/delivery archive; metadata and short pinpoint quotations only are published.

pinpoint_findings.short_quote: available as a calibrated standard of spectral radiance
pinpoint_findings.finding: Calibration is an available option, with documentation and 1 nm sampling from 115 to 400 nm. Actual experimental certificate, quantity units and reference plane are not supplied in this product document.
Nominal approximately 1 mm emitting diameter, polished c-cut MgF2 window and approximately f/7 output; not the complete experimental collection geometry.

pinpoint_findings.quote_verification: visual inspection of original embedded raster; absent from extracted page text
pinpoint_findings.finding: The displayed radiant-intensity unit has no area denominator and is not reconciled with page-1 spectral-radiance terminology. No serial calibration or experimental curve identity established.
The current model632.html URL describes Model 634 and approximately f/6. Keep separate from the legacy Model 632 approximately f/7 document; not a replacement calibration.

200 mm focal length, f/4.5 aperture, 32 degree incidence, 40 by 45 mm grating and settable slit height are generic geometry specifications; no complete experimental throughput or serial efficiency calibration is given.

1200 grooves/mm column gives dispersion 4 nm/mm and spectral resolution 0.1 nm FWHM. Footnote qualifies scanning tests at 184.9 or 312.6 nm with 10 µm slits and slowest aperture ratio; not the VUV shot line-spread function.

pinpoint_findings.location: Grating selection graph, 1200 g/mm Al+MgF2 curve
pinpoint_findings.finding: Ordinate ticks span 0 to 0.4 while the literal label says percent. No fraction/percent reinterpretation, extracted efficiency table or absolute correction is adopted. Theoretical grating efficiency is distinct from coating reflectance and complete instrument response.

pinpoint_findings.finding: Current page advertises newer Monarch while retaining Model 234/302 example spectra. The example response is relative, not a serial wavelength throughput calibration.

pinpoint_findings.finding: Window transmission and photocathode response must retain their reference planes.

pinpoint_findings.quote_verification: exact substring of whitespace-normalized extracted page text
pinpoint_findings.finding: The note defines photocathode QE as emitted photoelectrons divided by incident photocathode photons; it is not ADU per photon.

pinpoint_findings.short_quote: Phosphors with higher efficiency, measured as photons/electron at 5 kV
pinpoint_findings.quote_verification: exact substring of whitespace-normalized extracted page text
pinpoint_findings.finding: Phosphor conversion is a separate stage after MCP electron gain.

pinpoint_findings.short_quote: Multiple excitations can be integrated into a single CCD frame with the signal obtained from the same time offset from the excitation.
pinpoint_findings.quote_verification: exact substring of whitespace-normalized extracted page text
pinpoint_findings.finding: Readout-frame integration does not by itself specify optical gate exposure or number of gates.
MCP electron gain is a separate stage; it is not digital ADU per incident VUV photon.

Current table gives standard 50 ns and optional high-speed 3 ns minimum gates; synchronous one gate trigger per camera frame and asynchronous multiple gate triggers per frame. This does not recover actual shot gate waveforms, gate counts or effective exposure.
The current plot is generic average sensitivity with percent QE ordinate; it does not identify the historical S20/MgF2 custom assembly or an ADU/photon calibration.

factor_ownership_rule: Use the actual certificate quantity/reference plane and an explicit response chain. Do not multiply grating, window, photocathode, MCP or sensor terms again if already contained in an empirical calibrated count response.
